integrity: The displayed formulas have a self-contained analytic proof and finite rational corroboration. The stable-two-lottery convention and scope are explicit. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three candidates with four single-peaked strict ranking types and independently sampled defending copies. The arbitrary-profile iff criterion applies only when the middle candidate is strict Condorcet winner; no general solution with positive middle probability is supplied. Pre-existing general uniqueness and symmetric critical-endpoint construction are explicitly credited; historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: A sharp Condorcet-exclusion criterion and two support transitions for stable two-lotteries
